selection.rule: random.Random(f'{seed}:{type}').sample(sorted ids of type, per_type), sorted within type; types sorted

document_unit.rule: one user turn plus the assistant turns that follow it; leading assistant turns form their own round
document_unit.blank_rounds: blank (whitespace-only) rounds are not indexed by any arm; round IDs stay positional, so every other round's ID and the gold are unchanged; the count is recorded per question as blank_rounds_skipped

arms.setup: fathomdb_test_setup, embedder none, cpu; plain round bodies (v1 store shape)
fathomdb_test_setup, embedder default, FATHOMDB_EMBED_DEVICE; plain round bodies plus ProjectionSpec(name='dense', SEARCHABLE, vector=True); vector coverage checked per store

arms.method: table.search(query_type='fts'), native FTS index, library defaults

retrieval.order: arms rotate by question position: arm_order(index, arms) = arms[index % n:] + arms[:index % n]; for two arms this is v1's AB/BA alternation

judge.prompt: LongMemEval evaluate_qa per-type answer check, blinded to product

claim_boundary.reference: LanceDB Hermes LongMemEval-S experiment: 60 questions, top-5, answerer gpt-5.4, judge gpt-5.4-mini
claim_boundary.deviation: judge is gpt-5.4 (one step stronger than the reference judge), owner 2026-10-16
claim_boundary.scope: FTS arms plus FathomDB hybrid when the COMP-03 retrieval sweep verdict is adopt (--sweep-summary); top_k 10 for every arm; published Hermes scores and network-inclusive latency are context
claim_boundary.v1_difference: top_k 10 (v1: 5); arm IDs fathomdb-fts, lancedb-fts name the v1 arms fathomdb, lancedb
claim_boundary.unit_g: evidence policy 4000/30000/on from the offline G1/G2 verdict; recency off

decision_rule.rule: report only: v3 minus v2, paired per arm and per type; read against the verdict's answer_set_expectation
decision_rule.gate: adoption into the best mix follows the per-type direction on fathomdb-fts plus the 470-question offline metrics, not answer-run significance
